            Editor's note—
               Text Amd. No. 472, § 2, effective May 1, 2024, repealed the former App. A to Art. 53, and enacted a new App. A as set out herein. The former App. A pertained to similar
               subject matter Water-Dependent Uses and Facilities of Public Accommodation and derived
               from Text Amd. No. 464, §§ 3c., 5a., 11-8-2023.
